model: InceptionResnetV1 (facenet-pytorch), pretrained='vggface2'; trainable: block8, last_linear, last_bn + ArcFace head
dataset_version: LFW funneled full frames 250x250 (same files as the sklearn set)

split.rule: per-identity 70/15/15, np.random.default_rng(42) (notebook cell 8); identities shared across splits (closed-set)

preprocessing.alignment: bounding-box crop (landmarks used only for quality gates in enrollment, not here)

checkpoint_selection: final epoch (the notebook saves the model after the last epoch; there is no best-checkpoint selection)
differences_from_historical_notebook: validation loss, EER and AUC additionally logged (notebook logged val_acc only)
full-frame 250x250 LFW images instead of the sklearn 125x94 slice (see image_source)
controlled_variable: face preprocessing (bbox) - all else identical within the pair
